info.title: Autonomous CFO API
info.description:
REST API of the Autonomous CFO for Pizzeria Amalfi (dashboard backend).

* Versioned under `/v1`. Money is `{"amount": "1234.50", "currency": "EUR"}`, dates are ISO 8601, timestamps UTC.
* Errors always look like `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`.
* All read endpoints return data from the database (`"stub": false`); `"stub": true` (header `X-Stub: true`) would mark sample data.

Examples for every endpoint: `docs/api.md`.

get.description:
Balance, average monthly cash flow, the lowest forecast balance of the next 12 months, undocumented
payments (tax risk), pending approvals and open cost anomalies.

get.summary: Predicted bank balance with prediction interval and safety-buffer gaps
get.description:
XGBoost forecast of the daily net cash flow (T015), walked forward from the current balance. `gaps` lists
stretches below `safety_buffer` (D-013, draw it as a line); `gaps` and `lowest_point` always describe the
whole horizon, whatever the granularity. The interval is an approximation (holdout error of the model,
growing with the square root of the days ahead).

get.summary: Costs per team over a date range, with monthly breakdown
get.description:
Teams are sorted by total cost, highest first. Months are included when their first day is in range.
Costs without a team (tax, social security) appear as team `company`.

get.summary: Live stream of new decisions, approvals and events (SSE)
get.description:
Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`). Messages:

* `event: decision`, `data` = a decision like `GET /v1/decisions/{id}`;
* `event: approval`, `data` = an approval like `GET /v1/approvals/{id}` (sent when created and again when answered);
* `event: event`, `data` = a simulator event (`id`, `ts`, `kind`, `payload`).

Every message has an `id:` that is a resume token: after a disconnect `EventSource` sends it back as `Last-Event-ID`
and receives everything newer. Without it the stream starts from now (nothing is replayed). The server polls the
database about once a second and sends a `: keepalive` comment when nothing happens.
